With a population of 4.6 million concentrated mainly in Nouakchott and the south, the country is rich in natural resources (fishing, iron, gold, gas) and has experienced sustained economic growth. However, wealth distribution remains unequal, and social sector investment is limited. Poverty has declined significantly in recent years, yet many children remain highly vulnerable: over one quarter live in absolute poverty, while one third face risks from drought and flooding, leading to food insecurity and malnutrition. The Deputy Representative, Operations will be entrusted with the following five pillars, the core focus of all operations functions: Valuing People, Valuing Money, Valuing Risk Management, Valuing Systems and Structures, Valuing Partners.
